ui.title: Dashboard
ui.empty: No data for the selected period.
ui.emptyHint: Choose another period or other filters.
ui.professionalNote: Expenses and result do not apply to a professional.

appointments.label: Appointments
appointments.formula: Appointments in the period, excluding cancelled ones.

completed.label: Completed
completed.formula: Appointments in the period with status Completed.

occupancy.label: Occupancy rate
occupancy.formula: Booked minutes of non-cancelled appointments ÷ available minutes (working hours of the professionals minus time-offs and unit closures). Overlapping appointments count once.

cancellationRate.label: Cancellation rate
cancellationRate.formula: Cancelled ÷ all booked in the period.

newPatients.label: New patients
newPatients.formula: Patients registered in the period. With a unit or professional selected, counts those whose first appointment was in that unit or with that professional.

billed.label: Billed
billed.formula: Net amount of non-cancelled charges created in the period.

received.label: Received
received.formula: Payments minus refunds received in the period.

receivable.label: Receivable
receivable.formula: Open balance of non-cancelled charges created in the period.

paidExpenses.label: Paid expenses
paidExpenses.formula: Paid expenses plus manual cash withdrawals, without transfers or reversals.

result.label: Result
result.formula: Received + manual revenues (received revenues and cash entries) − paid expenses.

reports.title: Reports
reports.indexIntro: Choose a report to filter, generate and export.

descriptions.appointments: Every appointment of the period, with patient, service, professional, room, status and price.
descriptions.cancellations: Cancellations and no-shows with origin, reason and lead time, summarized by reason and by professional.
descriptions.revenue: Payments and refunds received, with subtotals by payment method, service, professional or unit.
descriptions.receivables: Open charges with balance, days open and aging buckets.
descriptions.productivity: Appointments, no-shows, cancellations, hours, billed, received and average ticket of each professional.

tooltips.daysOpen: A charge is due on issue. Days open = today minus the issue date, in the unit's time zone.
